about: Radio Hammer Station is an expanded port of Radiohammer, a rhythm action game where you match your button presses to the beat of the song!

Ensure peace in the world by slamming on your enemy using the power of funk! From zombies and aliens to horribly naughty perverts, the DJs of Radiohammer must face and overcome a wide variety of villainous baddies.
Includes all the songs from the original and more!
